name: r-analysis-workflow
description: Set up, document, report and review R biomedical analysis projects: analysis plans, AGENTS.md, Quarto explainer sites, GitHub workflow, and blind clinical, statistical, coding and librarian reviews.

interface.longDescription: Workflows for R analysis projects that publish their code and methods on GitHub: project setup from a shared blueprint, analysis plans (STROBE+RECORD, CHEERS 2022 or descriptive) with open decisions as GitHub issues, AGENTS.md with one row per data source and its access package, a Quarto site that explains each script from its actual source, reporting with flowchart, gtsummary, ggplot2 and ggsurvfit, collaborator onboarding, and reviews by independent clinician, clinician-researcher, statistician, coding-expert and librarian reviewers using only published material. Uses installed Posit skills where relevant.
defaultPrompt: Set up my R analysis project from my latest RMD and protocol.
Run a full blind review of this repository.
Write the Quarto page for the script I just added to main.R.
